_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Packaging Plan
summary: The Packaging Plan provides information on item characteristics, packaging, special handling, and transportability requirements, and packaging concepts applicable to an item being developed, to monitor and evaluate the contractor's packaging planning.
description_purpose:
The Packaging Plan contains information on the item characteristics; item packaging, special handling, and transportability requirements; and packaging concepts applicable to an item being developed.
The Packaging Plan provides information required to monitor and evaluate the development of the contractor's planning for packaging of an item.
application_interrelationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
The Packaging Plan is applicable to contracts which contain a requirement for the contractor to develop packaging requirements for an item.
The Packaging Plan is related to the following DIDs:
a. Packaging Test Plan DI-PACK-80456
b. Packaging Test Report DI-PACK-80457
c. Packaging Cost Analysis DI-PACK-80458
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Packaging Plan shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Packaging Plan content shall be as follows:

children.title: Title Page.
children.content: The title page shall include the contractor's name and address; contract number; project number; security classification; item, equipment or purchase description identification; and document title.

children.title: Item Description.
children.content: Describe the characteristics of the item as follows:

children.title: General description, materials of construction, and functional requirements of the unpackaged item.
Physical characteristics, waterproofness, fragility, and ruggedness of the unpackaged item.
Chemical properties and corrosion susceptibility of the unpackaged item.
Chemical and explosive hazards applicable to the unpackaged item.

Statement of essential or desired life expectancy requirements for the packaged item, i.e., when packaged, the item will be capable of operating after (desired) two years of open storage in a tropical environment, (essential) five years of covered storage in a tropical environment without humidity or temperature control, and (essential) ten years of covered storage in a temperate environment.
Transportability Characteristics.
children.content: Delineate information which addresses the capability of transporting the packaged item safely, efficiently, and effectively using the required modes of transportation.

children.title: Performance Requirements of Packaging.
children.content: Describe applicable shipping, handling, and storage environmental requirements for the packaged item as defined in the contract packaging Statement of Work.

children.title: Identification.
children.content: Describe standard and special marking requirements for packaging as defined in MIL-STD-129, Title 49 of the Code of Federal Regulations (49 CFR), and ASTM D3951.

children.title: Packaging Concepts.
children.content: Describe all packaging concepts being considered to include performance and cost factors.

children.title: Packaging Program Schedule and Data Sequence.
children.content: Detail the packaging development schedule (i.e., packaging plan, packaging design, prototype development and fabrication, inspection and testing, etc.) including the data development sequence as a function of time.

children.title: Revisions.
children.content: Major or minor changes to the Packaging Plan shall be issued as Packaging Plan revisions as follows:

children.title: The title page shall bear the notation - Revision - directly under Project Number.
children.content: Each revision shall use a sequential alphabetical letter after the word Revision to delineate the revision level.

children.title: Required minor changes (i.e., typographical errors) in the plan shall be made by issuing (completely) revised pages for those pages containing the minor changes.
children.content: Revised pages shall bear the same page numbers as the original pages.

children.title: Major changes (other than minor changes) in the plan shall be made by issuing completely revised pages for all original pages.
Signature, Title, and Date.
children.content: The Packaging Plan and Packaging Plan Revisions shall contain the signature and title of the contractor's authorized representative and shall include the date on which the signature was affixed.
